description: This Python source file defines API route handlers for managing 'Lead' entities in a web application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, transitioning, and deleting leads, using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy ORM. The file sets up an API router with prefix '/api/v1/leads' and contains functions that implement the RESTful interface for lead management, utilizing dependency injection for database sessions and user authentication.
